material:
name: "filters"
'on':
  push:
    branches: [main, 'release/**']
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 3 * * 1'
permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write
jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: windows-2022
    environment: production
    permissions: write-all
    steps:
      - run: echo "${{ secrets.DEPLOY_KEY }}"
  deploy:
    needs: [lint]
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on:
      group: prod-runners
      labels: [linux]
    steps:
      - run: ./deploy.sh ${{ secrets['API_TOKEN'] }}
note: gha-trigger-trust-model: lib.codec.gha_workflow/gha_answer via decode(rep='gha_workflow', transform=<field>[@job], key=<accepted csv>)
